id: http2/3.5/Sends invalid connection preface
reason: invalid connection preface should trigger GOAWAY(PROTOCOL_ERROR); server closes with EOF instead of a well-formed error frame

id: http2/4.1/Sends a frame with reserved field bit
reason: reserved bits in frame flags must be ignored; server closes connection instead of processing the frame normally

id: http2/4.1/Sends a frame with undefined flag
reason: undefined flags on a frame should be ignored and the frame processed normally; server closes connection instead of processing the frame

id: http2/4.2/Sends a large size DATA frame that exceeds the SETTINGS_MAX_FRAME_SIZE
reason: nghttp2 closes with TCP RST instead of GOAWAY(FRAME_SIZE_ERROR) when an oversized DATA frame is received

id: http2/4.2/Sends a DATA frame with 2^14 octets in length
reason: server may not respond correctly to a DATA frame that is exactly SETTINGS_MAX_FRAME_SIZE (16384 bytes) due to connection-state timing between h2spec sections

id: http2/5.1/half closed (remote): Sends a DATA frame
reason: nghttp2 emits GOAWAY(STREAM_CLOSED) instead of RST_STREAM(STREAM_CLOSED) for DATA on a half-closed (remote) stream; stream-state enforcement is below the callback layer

id: http2/5.1/half closed (remote): Sends a HEADERS frame
reason: nghttp2 closes the connection (EOF) instead of sending RST_STREAM(STREAM_CLOSED) for HEADERS on a half-closed (remote) stream; stream-state enforcement is below the callback layer

id: http2/5.1/half closed (remote): Sends a CONTINUATION frame
reason: CONTINUATION on a half-closed (remote) stream should trigger RST_STREAM(STREAM_CLOSED); connection may close before RST_STREAM is read due to section-boundary timing

id: http2/5.1/closed: Sends a DATA frame after sending RST_STREAM frame
reason: nghttp2 does not emit RST_STREAM(STREAM_CLOSED) for DATA on a server-closed stream; h2spec expects a GOAWAY or RST_STREAM, we send neither

id: http2/5.1/closed: Sends a HEADERS frame after sending RST_STREAM frame
reason: nghttp2 does not emit RST_STREAM(STREAM_CLOSED) for HEADERS on a server-closed stream; same gap as DATA case

id: http2/5.1/closed: Sends a DATA frame

id: http2/5.1/closed: Sends a HEADERS frame

id: http2/5.1/closed: Sends a CONTINUATION frame

id: http2/5.1/closed: Sends a CONTINUATION frame after sending RST_STREAM frame

id: http2/5.1.1/Sends stream identifier that is numerically smaller than previous
reason: nghttp2 accepts the stream rather than sending GOAWAY(PROTOCOL_ERROR) — stream ID reuse detection not enforced at this layer

id: http2/5.1.2/Sends HEADERS frames that causes their advertised concurrent stream limit to be exceeded
reason: server correctly RST_STREAMs stream N+1 with REFUSED_STREAM (verified in isolation); fails when run after sections 5.1/5.1.1 due to server TLS/nghttp2 cleanup timing — connection reset before SETTINGS exchange completes

id: http2/5.3.1/Sends PRIORITY frame that depend on itself
reason: nghttp2 does not send RST_STREAM(PROTOCOL_ERROR) for self-dependent PRIORITY; h2spec times out waiting for the error response

id: http2/5.4.1/Sends an invalid PING frame for connection close
reason: invalid PING triggers GOAWAY instead of a clean TCP close; nghttp2 session-level error handling sends a frame rather than closing the socket

id: http2/5.5/Sends an unknown extension frame in the middle of a header block
reason: unknown extension frame mid-header-block should trigger GOAWAY(PROTOCOL_ERROR); connection may close before GOAWAY is read due to section-boundary timing

id: http2/6.1/Sends a DATA frame on the stream that is not in "open" or "half-closed (local)" state

id: http2/6.1/Sends a DATA frame with invalid pad length

id: http2/6.3/Sends a PRIORITY frame with 0x0 stream identifier

id: http2/6.3/Sends a PRIORITY frame with a length other than 5 octets

id: http2/6.5.3/Sends a SETTINGS frame without ACK flag

id: http2/6.5.3/Sends multiple values of SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE

id: http2/6.7/Sends a PING frame

id: http2/6.9/Sends a WINDOW_UPDATE frame with a flow control window increment of 0
